advancements.zenkai.parry_projectile.des: Perfect-parry a ki projectile and send it back at whoever fired it
advancements.zenkai.parry_mastery.title: Perfect Timing
advancements.zenkai.parry_mastery.descri: Learn Parry Mastery: a wider window, a stronger counter, and ki and health back on every parry

item.zenkai.scissors.nothing_to_cut: Sorry, there's nothing to cut here :(
item.zenkai.scissors.majin_soon: Majins don't have hairstyles yet... soon there'll be something to cut!
race.zenkai.passive.saiyan.desc: Recovering from near death leaves you stronger for a while.
race.zenkai.passive.namekian.desc: Your body knits itself back together far faster, spending ki to do it.
race.zenkai.passive.majin.desc: Physical blows barely dent you, and you mend on your own. Energy still hurts.
race.zenkai.passive.arcosian.desc: Cold cannot touch you, and your innate ki costs less to shape.
race.zenkai.passive.human.desc: You earn more from training and catch your breath faster than anyone.
skill.zenkai.quick_step.desc: Vanish for an instant and reappear a few blocks away. Once learned, your double-tap dash becomes a Quick Step: it costs ki, is invulnerable while it lasts and your body fades from view. Every level lowers the ki cost and the cooldown.
skill.zenkai.fly.desc: Be able to fly using ki.
skill.zenkai.ki_control.desc: Channel your power output at 100%. Each level increases power output by 5%
skill.zenkai.meditation.desc: Channel your ki. Required to charge (C) at all; each level speeds up charging and passive ki regeneration.
skill.zenkai.parry_mastery.desc: Everyone can parry with the Parry key. This skill sharpens it: each level widens the parry window and strengthens your counter-attack; higher levels also return ki and heal your body on every successful parry.
skill.zenkai.ki_block.desc: Reinforce your guard with ki. Cuts 20% of incoming damage while blocking, up to 50% at max level. A weapon in your main hand cuts less; a shield in your off hand cuts more and does not slow you down.
skill.zenkai.ki_sense.desc: Feel the ki around you. Extends sensing range, reveals stamina and ki of those you sense, and lets you lock on to a target.
skill.zenkai.kaioken.desc: Multiply your power at the cost of your own body. Higher levels unlock stronger multipliers and reduce the health drain.
skill.zenkai.super_forms.desc: Awaken your potential and unlock your race's transformations, one per level.
skill.zenkai.god_ki.desc: Divine ki: the gate to your race's divine forms and to the doctrines of the gods. Not bought: a master's trial, a ritual of warriors, or a divine office grants it.
skill.zenkai.ki_infuse.desc: Channel ki through your weapons and projectiles. Each level increases the damage your willpower adds to an infused strike, spent from your ki on top of the usual stamina cost. It also infuses your shield: blocking with one cuts more damage for a little ki per hit.
skill.zenkai.ki_fist.desc: Wrap your fists in ki. Melee attacks and physical techniques hit harder the more spirit you have, spending ki on top of their usual stamina cost.
screen.zenkai.skills_tree.mode_mine: My skills: your head in the middle and only what you own, with the ki weapons born from Ki Infuse + Ki Fist.
screen.zenkai.skills_tree.mode_masters: Back to the tree by master.
screen.zenkai.skills_tree.weapon_toggle_: Click: turn on or off. Right-click twice: forget it and get the TP back.
skill.zenkai.ki_sword.desc: Shapes the ki your main hand channels into a sword. Needs Ki Infuse and Ki Fist. Toggle it on and off without forgetting it; one main-hand weapon at a time.
skill.zenkai.ki_axe.desc: Shapes your main-hand ki into an axe. Needs Ki Infuse and Ki Fist. One main-hand weapon at a time.
skill.zenkai.ki_mace.desc: Shapes your main-hand ki into a mace. Needs Ki Infuse and Ki Fist. One main-hand weapon at a time.
skill.zenkai.ki_scythe.desc: Shapes your main-hand ki into a scythe. Needs Ki Infuse and Ki Fist. One main-hand weapon at a time.
skill.zenkai.ki_hammer.desc: Shapes your main-hand ki into a hammer. Needs Ki Infuse and Ki Fist. One main-hand weapon at a time.
skill.zenkai.ki_shield.desc: A ki shield in your (empty) off hand. Needs Ki Infuse and Ki Fist; works with any ki weapon.
skill.zenkai.potential_unlock.desc: Draw out the power sleeping inside you. Costs no ki to hold, but locks you out of every other transformation.
skill.zenkai.ultra_instinct.desc: Tap into Ultra Instinct's reflexes while staying in whatever transformation you're already in. Separate from the full Ultra Instinct transformation itself.
skill.zenkai.arcosian_power.desc: Innate to Arcosians. Hold your power below 50% to store Power Points (faster in Base than in the Second and Third forms; in those also by fighting) and spend them at 100%+ power from the Final Form: the higher the form, the more it burns and the more it gives. Each level enlarges the tank, and a bigger tank lasts longer.
message.zenkai.ui_overheat: Your body is spent! You can't dodge until it cools down.
message.zenkai.ui_recovered: Your body has recovered: you can dodge again.
skill.zenkai.namek_giant.desc: Grow to giant size at will, on top of whatever form you are in (yes, Orange too). Toggle it from the wheel. Bigger target, bigger reach.
skill.zenkai.ultra_ego.desc: Channel the power of destruction. While the technique is on (always on in the Ultra Ego form), your physical techniques ignore part of the target's defense, up to 20% at level 10. Level 5 unlocks the Ultra Ego transformation, where the damage you take builds a bar that boosts your stats; the higher the level, the higher that boost can go.
skill.zenkai.instant_transmission.desc: Lock onto a ki signature or the point you're looking at and blink there instantly. Higher levels lower the ki cost and cooldown and extend the range.
screen.zenkai.instant_transmission.title: Instant Transmission
screen.zenkai.instant_transmission.locke: You haven't found this place yet
screen.zenkai.instant_transmission.party: No party members to show yet

technique.zenkai.wave.desc: Kamehameha-style beam: slow to charge, but very strong.
technique.zenkai.blast.desc: Standard ball. Balanced in every way.
technique.zenkai.barrier.desc: Defensive bubble that follows you and absorbs damage. Doesn't attack.
technique.zenkai.burst.desc: Fires several small balls in a spread.
technique.zenkai.disk.desc: Cutting disk: pierces through everything it hits.
technique.zenkai.explosion.desc: Self-detonation centered on you: doesn't travel, doesn't aim.
technique.zenkai.spirit_bomb.desc: A signature technique only King Kai can teach: a slow, colossal sphere of gathered energy. While you charge it, nearby non-hostile creatures and party members who are charging ki lend it their energy and make it hit harder (an evil alignment draws it from hostile mobs instead).
technique.zenkai.kamehameha.desc: A signature technique: the archetypal beam, blazing blue-white and devastating.
technique.zenkai.final_flash.desc: A signature technique: a very wide golden beam after a long, crackling charge.
technique.zenkai.galick_gun.desc: A signature technique: a dense, violet beam of compact energy.
technique.zenkai.death_beam.desc: A signature technique: a needle-thin, near-instant beam of pinpoint precision.
technique.zenkai.death_ball.desc: A signature technique: an enormous sphere, dark at its core, crackling at the rim.
technique.zenkai.supernova.desc: A signature technique: a colossal sphere of solid, sun-like energy.
technique.zenkai.effect.explosive.desc: Breaks blocks in the blast radius. Costs more ki.
technique.zenkai.effect.piercing.desc: Passes through the first target hit and keeps flying.
technique.zenkai.effect.homing.desc: Gently curves toward your Ki Sense lock-on target.
technique.zenkai.effect.lingering.desc: Leaves a zone that keeps burning for a few seconds.
technique.zenkai.effect.fragmentation.de: Bursts into 3-4 smaller balls on impact.
physical.zenkai.dash_punch.desc: Dash forward and hit everything in your path with a single strike.
physical.zenkai.heavy_blow.desc: A slow, crushing blow that hits one target very hard.
physical.zenkai.barrage.desc: A flurry of rapid punches in front of you. Each hit is weak, but they add up.
physical.zenkai.kiai.desc: A shockwave all around you: pushes everyone away, breaks the guard of anyone blocking and knocks aside enemy ki projectiles. Costs more stamina for every extra target.
physical.zenkai.rising_slash.desc: A swift upward cut in front of you that launches whoever it hits into the air. Needs a sword or any ki weapon in hand.
physical.zenkai.cross_slash.desc: Two quick diagonal cuts that draw an X in front of you. Each cut hits separately. Needs a sword or any ki weapon in hand.
physical.zenkai.piercing_thrust.desc: You lunge forward in a straight line and run through everything in your path, hitting each target once. Needs a sword or any ki weapon in hand.
physical.zenkai.spin_slash.desc: A full spin that cuts everything around you and pushes it away. Needs a sword or any ki weapon in hand.
physical.zenkai.sky_cleave.desc: A heavy overhead cut that breaks the guard of anyone blocking and bursts on impact. Slow to recover. Needs a sword or any ki weapon in hand.
physical.zenkai.light_blade.desc: You swing and a crescent of ki flies out of the cut, piercing through everything in a straight line until it fades or hits a wall. Needs a sword or any ki weapon in hand.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj_green.hint: There is a saiyan so powerful that his own people preferred he did not exist. A huge, furious form; it is not learned, it is granted.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj_green_max.hint: When the rage no longer fits in the body, the body grows. Master the green fury to reach its peak, at a heavy ki cost.
screen.zenkai.skill_tree.state.condition: Not bought with TP: granted by a wish to Shenlong
Not bought with TP: earned by mastering the previous form
screen.zenkai.wish.legendary.desc: Awakens the blood of a legendary saiyan in you. Its path is revealed: Ikari (the fury), Super Saiyan, Legendary Super Saiyan (green hair, a bigger body, a fury that cannot tell friend from foe) and Full Power Legendary.
screen.zenkai.wish.legendary.warning: Irreversible and for saiyan only. A Legendary can NOT use SSJ2 or SSJ3 (they can still be bought to progress toward SSJ4 and the gods). Legendary forms burn A LOT of ki: the power is not free.
messages.zenkai.legendary: The legendary blood awakens in you.
messages.zenkai.wish.legendary_saiyan_on: Only a Saiyan can wish to become Legendary.
skill_tree.zenkai.ikari.hint: Fury comes before gold. The first form of the legendary blood: raw, cheap power that opens the Ikari → Super Saiyan → Legendary chain.
skill_tree.zenkai.req.legendary_blocked: Blocked: the legendary blood does not allow it (it still counts toward progress)
message.zenkai.beast_fury: Rage floods your Mystic power — Beast unlocked!
message.zenkai.oozaru.ssj4_unlocked: The moon's power settles into you — Super Saiyan 4 unlocked!
message.zenkai.oozaru.hint_super: You feel you could unleash an even greater power...
message.zenkai.oozaru.hint_ssj4: The moon is still calling you. Your Saiyan power can reach further still...
scouter.zenkai.upgrade.range.desc: How far the targeting beam reaches
scouter.zenkai.upgrade.pl_cap.desc: Highest reading the lens can take before it burns out
physical.zenkai.absorb.desc: Innate to Majin. Throw a mass the color of your skin: if it hits someone you out-power by enough you absorb them even at full health; otherwise only if they are under 30% health and do not outclass you by much. You gain mass (extra stats for a while) and each form changes what it does.
messages.zenkai.absorb.not_majin: Only Majin know how to absorb.
messages.zenkai.absorb.pvp_off: Absorbing other players is disabled in this world.
messages.zenkai.absorb.too_healthy: It still has too much health: weaken it first.
messages.zenkai.absorb.too_strong: It is too strong to absorb.
messages.zenkai.absorb.no_ki: You do not have the ki to absorb.
hud.zenkai.combat.no_techniques: Assign techniques in the Techniques menu
physical.zenkai.evade.desc: Super Explosive Wave: you plant yourself motionless (on the ground or in the air), compress your ki and release it in one go as a dome that pushes away everything around you, ki attacks included. You are untouchable while it lasts. It deals no damage and has a long cooldown. It is the way out of a grab.
physical.zenkai.dive.desc: You plunge from the air and blast the ground on landing: area damage that scales with how far you fell. Only while flying and from some height.
physical.zenkai.grab.desc: Seize a nearby foe with your free hand and hold them in front of you with no time limit: they cannot move or act and you can hit them with your other hand. Press again to hurl them at whatever is ahead; if they crash, they get slammed and stunned. A grabbed player only breaks free by hitting the reflex bar, using Evade or Instant Transmission. Bosses cannot be grabbed.
hud.zenkai.dive_needs_flight: Dive needs you to be flying higher up
zenkai.grab.title: GRABBED!
config.zenkai.ki_sense_camera_shake.desc: Shake the camera when your ki sense warns you of a threat. The warning sound is unaffected.
config.zenkai.flight_fx_dust.desc: Kicks up dust and debris from the ground when flying fast and low.
config.zenkai.flight_fx_sonic_boom.desc: A ring and a boom, once, each time you break the speed threshold.
config.zenkai.flight_fx_landing.desc: A dust ring when you land at high speed.
config.zenkai.ki_fist_aura.desc: Draw ki-coloured energy around your fists (yours and other players') while Ki Fist is on, and the destruction energy of Ultra Ego.
config.zenkai.ki_infuse_glow.desc: Make the weapon in hand glow with the wielder's aura while Ki Infuse is on.
config.zenkai.sword_technique_fx.desc: Draw slash arcs, shockwaves and streaks when a sword technique is used.
config.zenkai.aura_power_growth.desc: How much your aura grows as your power rises, relative to the default. 100% = default (minimum); higher values make a powerful aura grow more.
How visible your own aura is to you in first person. 0% hides it completely, 100% shows it at full strength.
config.zenkai.ki_first_person_opacity.de: How visible your own charging/releasing ki ball is to you in first person. 0% hides it completely, 100% shows it at full strength.
config.zenkai.clash_bar_orientation.desc: Orientation of the timing bar shown when two beams clash. 0 = horizontal, under the crosshair; 1 = vertical, to its right.
zenkai.clash.join.far: Too far away to join this clash
zenkai.clash.join.full: That side of the clash is full
zenkai.clash.join.party: You can't join against your own party
zenkai.clash.join.no_technique: Select an offensive ki technique to join
config.zenkai.ki_bloom_enabled.desc: Real screen-space glow around ki techniques. Turn it off if it costs you too many FPS. Automatically disabled while a shader pack (Iris/Oculus) is active, which handles its own glow.
config.zenkai.ki_first_person_animations: Show your own body animating while you charge and fire ki techniques in first person. When off you see vanilla hands instead; other players still see the full animation.
config.zenkai.aura_bloom_enabled.desc: Real glow around auras: their core, sparks and lightning. Uses the same bloom pass as ki techniques but has its own switch. Turn it off if big auras cost you too many FPS.
config.zenkai.aura_system.desc: New: the composed aura, each form with its own visual family (flame, divine, dark...). Classic: the classic aura, lighter — use it if the new one costs you too many FPS.
config.zenkai.parry_trigger.desc: Key: only the parry key (default). Block: pressing the guard button opens the parry window and the real guard starts a moment later (tap = parry, hold = block). Both: either.
config.zenkai.aura_classic_quality.desc: Only with the Classic aura. Full: detail drops only with distance. Medium, Low and Minimal make it lighter even up close, for more FPS.
config.zenkai.hud_bars_scale.desc: Size of the Body/Stamina/Ki bars in the HUD, as a percent of their native texture size. Lower it if they look too big for your GUI Scale or screen resolution. The Modern style snaps to whole pixels so it stays sharp.
config.zenkai.hud_bars_style.desc: Modern: pixel-art frame with your portrait, damage trail and ki segments; the frame takes the colour of your transformation. Minimalist: the simple bars.
config.zenkai.hud_bars_values.desc: What the bars show inside: Numbers (current / max) or Percent.
config.zenkai.hud_frame_color.desc: Frame colour of the Modern HUD in base form (black by default). Click to pick a colour.
config.zenkai.hud_frame_follows_form.des: On: the Modern HUD frame takes the colour of your transformation, shifting while you transform. Off: it always keeps your frame colour. Warnings (critical health, strain, no stamina) show either way.
screen.zenkai.client_config.title: Client Settings
screen.zenkai.client_config.ki_sense_sha: Shake the camera when a power far above yours appears nearby.
screen.zenkai.hud_placement.title: Place Technique Bar
screen.zenkai.hud_placement.hint: Drag the bar where you want it
screen.zenkai.client_config.hud_layout.d: Move the technique bar and choose how it sits on screen.
screen.zenkai.master_techniques.empty: You haven't learned any master techniques yet.
screen.zenkai.master_techniques.create_f: You already have %s ki techniques. Delete one to remake this.
screen.zenkai.skill_tree.state.condition: Not bought with TP: it comes by itself
Sealed: ask a master (Tori-Bot) for a divine audience
screen.zenkai.skill_tree.confirm: Click again to confirm · no refunds
screen.zenkai.skill_tree.state.condition: Triggers on its own: look at the full moon with your tail
screen.zenkai.skill_tree.sealed: Sealed: divine ki is beyond mortals
screen.zenkai.skill_tree.center: Center on my form (double click: also reset zoom)
screen.zenkai.training_hub.row.shadow.to: Spar against a clone of yourself, scaled from 5% to 200% of your own power. It starts neutral and only turns hostile once you strike it - beating it (or just landing hits) grants a large amount of TP, boosted by the same weights/HTC bonuses as any other training.
screen.zenkai.training_hub.row.shadow.sh: Spar against a clone of yourself and earn TP with every hit.
screen.zenkai.training_hub.panel.title: TP Modifiers
screen.zenkai.training_hub.panel.fatigue: No training fatigue right now. It builds up as you earn TP this way, and decays by %s per minute of real time you spend not earning it.
Decays by %s per minute. Back to full efficiency in ~%s min.
Very fatigued right now - decays by %s per minute, but the exact recovery time isn't shown at this extreme.
screen.zenkai.meditation.result.title: Session complete
screen.zenkai.target_practice.result.los: You hit a bomb - round ended early!
screen.zenkai.target_practice.intro: Click the glowing orbs before they fade. Watch out for bombs/skulls - popping one ends the round early, but you keep every orb you already popped. You can also end it yourself anytime (Back/Escape) without losing anything you've earned.
screen.zenkai.target_practice.intro.shor: Click the orbs before they fade. Avoid bombs and skulls.
screen.zenkai.meditation.overview: Hit the falling notes in each lane (arrow keys by default) right as they cross the line at the bottom. Pick Free Practice for a procedural drill with adjustable difficulty and length, or choose a song below for a real chart with its own fixed difficulty and duration. gui.zenkai.piece_connector.explain: This connector attaches to any other piece that has a connector with the SAME socket, facing the opposite way. The face it points to decides which way the connection "goes out".
gui.zenkai.piece_connector.rotate.toolti: Cycles through the 6 directions. It only changes the block when you press Save.
gui.zenkai.piece_connector.example: Example: a hut has a connector with socket zenkai:namek_path facing SOUTH. A hallway has a connector with the same socket at each end. The engine rotates the hallway until one of its connectors faces NORTH (the opposite of south) and attaches it right there — the hallway's other end stays open for the next piece.

messages.zenkai.master.too_weak: %s: You need to become stronger before I can teach you.
messages.zenkai.master.alignment: %s: I have nothing to teach someone like you.
messages.zenkai.master.kami.first_meetin: %s: Welcome, young one. I am the guardian of the Earth. When you are ready, I can teach you to see beyond what your eyes show.
messages.zenkai.master.korin.first_meeti: %s: Meow! Finally someone made it up here. I'm Korin; if you really want to be fast and strong, come closer and let's talk.
messages.zenkai.master.kaio.first_meetin: %s: Hahaha! You've come a long way for someone alive. I am King Kai. Come, I'll teach you to control your energy.
messages.zenkai.master.toribot.first_mee: %s: A new character in my notebook! I'm the robot Akira Toriyama drew himself as, and here I am, pen at the ready to teach you techniques found in no other volume.
messages.zenkai.namekian.refuses_evil: The Namekian backs away in fear and refuses to trade with you.
messages.zenkai.master.no_race: %s: I don't know who you are yet. Come back once you do.
messages.zenkai.master.kami.no_race.0: %s: From this lookout I can see the whole Earth, yet I can't make you out. Discover who you are, and then we'll talk.
messages.zenkai.master.kami.no_race.1: %s: Power without roots is like a seed without soil. Find your origin first, young one.
messages.zenkai.master.kami.no_race.2: %s: As Guardian of the Earth, I cannot guide someone who hasn't chosen their path.
messages.zenkai.master.korin.no_race.0: %s: And who are you supposed to be? I don't teach anyone who doesn't even know where they come from.
messages.zenkai.master.korin.no_race.1: %s: I've been in this tower for eight hundred years, and I know a warrior when I see one. You're not one yet.
messages.zenkai.master.korin.no_race.2: %s: Hmm... no. First decide what kind of warrior you are. Now let me sleep.
messages.zenkai.master.kaio.no_race.0: %s: Why didn't the raceless warrior come to train? He couldn't find his place! ...Nothing? Come back when you know who you are.
messages.zenkai.master.kaio.no_race.1: %s: To train with me you have to make me laugh... and know who you are. Right now you've got neither.
messages.zenkai.master.kaio.no_race.2: %s: You came all this way without even knowing your race? Now that's a good one! But I'm not teaching you like that.
messages.zenkai.master.toribot.no_race.0: %s: Hmm, I haven't designed this character yet. Come back when you're finished.
messages.zenkai.master.toribot.no_race.1: %s: A character with no race? I wouldn't approve that even in a rough draft.
messages.zenkai.master.toribot.no_race.2: %s: I've got a deadline coming up... Come back when you know who you are and I'll draw you a technique.
messages.zenkai.korin.no_senzu: Korin has none left today. Come back tomorrow.

zenkai.ponder.piece_connector.text_1: Each zenkai:piece_connector marks an attachment point on an NBT piece
zenkai.ponder.piece_connector.text_2: Right-click opens an editor: rotate the active face and set the socket there
zenkai.ponder.piece_connector_example.te: This is Piece A: a structure fragment saved in its own NBT
Its connector points outward (FACING) - this is where it expects to latch onto another piece
The engine searches the catalog for a Piece B with a connector of the SAME socket
zenkai:namek_path, for example - the same free-form text on both pieces
It rotates it to fit face-to-face and checks it doesn't collide with what's already placed
Both connectors are always discarded: they never end up in the finished piece
zenkai.ponder.scouter_bench.text_1: Insert a scouter to repair it, upgrade it, or change its color from here
zenkai.ponder.scouter_bench.text_2: Repairing and upgrading cost materials from your inventory and take a few seconds
zenkai.ponder.scouter_bench.text_3: Color tinting is instant: it only spends FE, it doesn't go through that work queue
The generator burns fuel and produces FE for as long as the charge lasts
No cables: every tick it looks for an FE receiver on its 6 faces and pushes whatever it accepts
Just keep them touching - the bench uses that FE to repair and upgrade the scouter
zenkai.ponder.energy_generator.text_1: Right-click with fuel to load it; it's consumed whole the moment it ignites
zenkai.ponder.energy_generator.text_2: No cables needed: it pushes FE to any of its six faces while burning
zenkai.ponder.all_dragon_balls.text_1: You need all seven dragon balls, one of each star
zenkai.ponder.all_dragon_balls.text_2: Place them in an H shape: two columns of three balls, inside a 3x3 grid
zenkai.ponder.all_dragon_balls.text_3: The LAST ball you place must be the one in the CENTER of the H: it's the one that closes the shape
zenkai.ponder.all_dragon_balls.text_4: The moment the H closes, the seven merge into a single block: All the Dragon Balls
zenkai.ponder.all_dragon_balls.text_5: Right-click it to activate: it summons Shenron, brings the night and grants wishes
zenkai.ponder.all_dragon_balls.text_6: Each player has to wait between wishes. If you break the block, you get the seven balls back
zenkai.ponder.namek_all_dragon_balls.tex: You need all seven Namekian dragon balls, one of each star
Place them in an H shape: two columns of three balls, inside a 3x3 grid
The LAST ball you place must be the one in the CENTER of the H: it's the one that closes the shape
The moment the H closes, the seven merge into a single block: All the Namekian Dragon Balls
Right-click it to activate: Porunga has no model yet, so it summons Shenlong with 3 wishes
Each player has to wait between wishes. If you break the block, you get the seven balls back

skill_tree.zenkai.ssj1.hint: When the pain is bigger than you, the hair turns gold. Raises all your stats; it is the door to every other Saiyan form.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj2.hint: The spark becomes a storm. More attack and stats than the last form, but the ki melts away.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj3.hint: A power that barely fits in the body. A big jump in stats and a huge hunger for ki.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj4.hint: Something ancient sleeps beneath the golden rage. A ritual awakens it: a wild, strong form you can control.
skill_tree.zenkai.oozaru.hint: The full moon calls to the blood. Turns you into a huge, unstoppable giant; it is not chosen, it happens.
skill_tree.zenkai.super_oozaru.hint: Whoever learns to tame the beast finds it can still grow. The hidden step toward the wild form.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj_god.hint: A power that is not obtained, it is received. The first divine step: far more output for every drop of ki.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj_blue.hint: The power of the gods with the mind intact. Gives more and burns less ki than any mortal form.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj_rose.hint: A divine power with an office and no mercy. Performs like Blue, in a color that forgives nothing.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj_blue_evolution.hin: Blue was never the limit. Much more power, at an enormous ki cost.
skill_tree.zenkai.ssj_rose_evolution.hin: Even the divine has a second gear. Much more power, at an enormous ki cost.
skill_tree.zenkai.human_super.hint: A human holds in what others let spill. Raises your stats at very little cost: your first step.
skill_tree.zenkai.human_ultra.hint: The mind clears like still water. More power and reflexes; the second step of discipline.
skill_tree.zenkai.human_indomitable_spir: Some fall and some get back up. Huge power for those who never give in, at a high ki cost.
skill_tree.zenkai.human_flow.hint: You stop fighting the ki and let it run. Less power than willpower, but it costs far less: built for long fights.
skill_tree.zenkai.human_god.hint: Humans have no ceiling; they only needed to look up. It is the human divine step: every ally nearby pushes you and, if you are alone, every chained hit you land without being touched.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.namek_giant.hint: Namekians grow when needed. A toggle: makes you a giant and adds stats on top of whatever form you wear.
skill_tree.zenkai.namek_orange.hint: There is an orange scarier than any scream. The first form of the Namekian chain: raises your stats.
skill_tree.zenkai.namek_god.hint: Even the wisest accepts a push from the sky. It is the Namekian divine step: it heals you nonstop and costs almost no ki.
skill_tree.zenkai.second_form.hint: Holding back was a cage. You release part of your strength without spending ki: steady power.
skill_tree.zenkai.third_form.hint: The cage breaks a little more. More power, no ki drain.
skill_tree.zenkai.final_form.hint: The greatest power in the smallest body. Your strongest form with no drain.
skill_tree.zenkai.golden_form.hint: After a thousand days of training, even you shine. A golden power branch, meant to be mastered with patience.
skill_tree.zenkai.black_form.hint: When gold darkens, courtesy ends. The dark branch: more raw power, less control.
skill_tree.zenkai.arcosian_god.hint: Even the coldest ice keeps a divine fire. It is the Arcosian divine step: its Power Point tank becomes twice as big, drains at half the speed and gives much more while you wear it.
skill_tree.zenkai.fifth_form.hint: They say there is a form beyond the final one. Rumors pay no taxes.
skill_tree.zenkai.golden_fifth_form.hint: A form no emperor should know.
skill_tree.zenkai.black_fifth_form.hint: The last thing you will see is your own dark reflection.
skill_tree.zenkai.majin_pure_evil.hint: Your body awakens and everything looks edible. Raises your stats: the first step of hunger.
skill_tree.zenkai.majin_super.hint: The more you absorb, the more fits. You hold more stacks of absorbed mass, and each stack gives more power.
skill_tree.zenkai.majin_harmony.hint: You keep what you swallow and find calm. Mass lasts twice as long: sustained power for long fights.
skill_tree.zenkai.majin_pure_chaos.hint: You let it all out at once. Each stack of mass is worth more but fades sooner: burst power.
skill_tree.zenkai.majin_god.hint: The original Majin, before the corruption. Divine step: absorbed mass is not lost while you wear it.
A wise old man can awaken what slept in you. Raises your stats based on your best form and opens the way to the Beast.
skill_tree.zenkai.beast.hint: Losing what you love most makes something roar inside. Very high, unstable power: your fury unleashed.
skill_tree.zenkai.ultra_instinct_sign.hi: Your body moves before your mind. You dodge by instinct: the first step toward Ultra Instinct.
skill_tree.zenkai.ultra_instinct.hint: Perfect calm, perfect emptiness. You dodge almost everything and perform like few forms, while you master it.
skill_tree.zenkai.ultra_ego.hint: The more they hit you, the stronger you get. Your power grows with the damage you take.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.god_ki.hint: A chain no mortal breaks. Nothing divine opens without it: seek whoever knows the heavens.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.god_ki.hint_enabl: You have permission to look. Break the chain and everything divine opens.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.ultra_instinct.hi: Only those who have looked upon the gods understand the silence. Each level deepens the angels' instinct.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.ultra_ego.hint: The god of destruction gives nothing, except blows. Each level deepens the destroyer's doctrine.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.race_saiyan.hint: Every time you nearly die, you return stronger. After a brush with death you get a temporary surge of power.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.race_namekian.hin: A missing arm is an arm that grows back. You regenerate your body, at a ki cost.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.race_majin.hint: You bounce, and what breaks you closes again. Reduces the physical damage you take and heals you on its own.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.race_arcosian.hin: The cold of space is your parlor. Your techniques cost less ki.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.race_human.hint: No biological ceiling: only effort. You earn more TP when training and recover stamina faster.
skill_tree.zenkai.node.arcosian_power.hi: Keep the rage for when you need it. You store contained power that is released all at once in the higher forms.
master.zenkai.service.god_ki_audience.al: You already have the audience: face the trial
master.zenkai.service.god_ki_trial.busy: Finish your current shadow fight first
message.zenkai.god_ki.audience_granted: The master looks at you for a long time. "Very well. Prove it." The chain of divine ki trembles.
message.zenkai.god_ki.trial_start: Your shadow rises, stronger than you. Defeat it.
message.zenkai.god_ki.trial_failed: The trial is over. You can try again whenever you want.
message.zenkai.god_ki.ritual_done_helper: %s has reached the power of the gods.
messages.zenkai.needs_god_ki: The doctrines of the gods need God Ki
advancements.zenkai.god_ki_ritual.title: Is This the Power of the Gods?
advancements.zenkai.god_ki_ritual.descri: A level never meant for mortals
advancements.zenkai.god_ki_trial.title: Worthy of the Sky
advancements.zenkai.god_ki_trial.descrip: Defeat your shadow in the master's divine trial
config.zenkai.skill_tree_reduced_effects: Turns off the animated backgrounds, twinkling stars and pulsing frames of the transformation tree.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.1: Every form of your race and the universal paths live here. Drag to move around; the mouse wheel zooms in steps.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.2: The tree starts at your Base. Each branch hangs from the node that opens it; your racial passive hangs here too and can be upgraded.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.3: Nodes cost Training Points and some take free Mind. Earn TP training, fighting and in the Training tab.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.4: Hover a node: its requirements show in green (met) or red (missing), with a hint about how to get it. Locked nodes show their hint from the start; secret ones appear only when you discover them.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.5: Click a glowing node, then click it again to buy it. There are no refunds. Right-click any node to light up the route to it and see its total cost.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.6: The magnifier resets the zoom. The other button centers the tree on your current form; double-click it to also reset the zoom.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.7: Divine ki is sealed behind this chain. Ask a master for a divine audience, beat his trial, or gather warriors for the ritual.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.skill_tree.8: This button shows this tutorial again whenever you want.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.training_hub.1: Fight a copy of yourself at the strength you choose. Every hit and the final blow give TP.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.training_hub.2: A rhythm minigame: keep your focus and earn TP without fighting.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.training_hub.3: Hit the targets with your ki. Precision pays.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.training_hub.4: Each kind of training tires you separately: the more you repeat one, the less it gives. Weights and the Hyperbolic Time Chamber multiply everything.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.training_hub.5: Train under heavier gravity for more TP, if your body can take it.
screen.zenkai.tutorial.training_hub.6: This button shows this tutorial again whenever you want.
zenkai.body.title: Body of %s
zenkai.body.party_notice: %1$s has died. Their body is at %2$s, %3$s, %4$s (%5$s).
skill_tree.zenkai.human_legendary.hint: They say a man's will has no ceiling, even if it breaks. It grows slowly with your power, and much more with God Ki; in return you do not cover yourself: you take more damage.
skill_tree.zenkai.namek_legendary.hint: The blood of Namek's ancestors does not sleep: it fuses with yours. It grows slowly with your power and much more with God Ki; you no longer heal on your own, only by fighting.
skill_tree.zenkai.majin_legendary.hint: The mass you absorb does not vanish: it stays and feeds you. It grows slowly with your power; every absorption steals part of the rival's power and gives ki back, and the mass lasts much longer.
screen.zenkai.wish.legendary.desc.human: Awakens the legendary will of humans in you. A form of your own race is revealed, Unleashed Will: a lot of power that grows slowly with yours, at the price of taking more damage. With God Ki its power surpasses a god's.
screen.zenkai.wish.legendary.desc.nameki: Awakens the ancestral blood of Namek in you. A form of your own race is revealed, Ancestral Fusion: a lot of power that grows slowly with yours, with no natural regeneration but healing with every hit you land. With God Ki its power surpasses a god's.
screen.zenkai.wish.legendary.desc.arcosi: Awakens your race's broken restraint. A transformation of your own is revealed, Broken Restraint, activated from an Arcosian form. With God Ki its power surpasses a god's.
screen.zenkai.wish.legendary.desc.majin: Awakens the hunger of the primordial Majin in you. A form of your own race is revealed, Devouring Majin, which grows slowly with your power. With God Ki its power surpasses a god's.
screen.zenkai.wish.legendary.warning.oth: Irreversible. The legendary form burns A LOT of ki: the power is not free.
messages.zenkai.wish.legendary_majin_exc: You cannot become Legendary while bearing the Majin mark.
messages.zenkai.arcosian_legendary.colla: The restraint breaks completely: your body collapses.
skill_tree.zenkai.pp.how: They charge with your power below 50% (faster in Base than in the Second and Third forms, and by fighting in those). They are spent at 100% power or more from the Final Form.
